Senior Data Analyst
Tailwind Freight (synthetic posting for tests)
Leeds, hybrid

About Tailwind Freight
Tailwind Freight runs same-day logistics for retailers across the north of England. Our data team turns delivery, warehouse and pricing data into decisions that operations and finance teams act on every week.

The role
We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst to own delivery performance reporting and support pricing decisions. You will build and maintain dbt models, design Looker dashboards, and present findings to operations leaders.

What you will do
- Own the on-time delivery and cost-per-drop metrics end to end, from SQL models to dashboards
- Build and maintain data models in dbt on Snowflake
- Design self-serve Looker dashboards for regional operations managers
- Run A/B tests on routing and pricing changes and explain the results to non-technical stakeholders
- Partner with finance on pricing analysis and forecasting
- Mentor junior analysts and review their SQL

What we are looking for (must have)
- 5+ years in data analysis or analytics engineering
- Expert SQL and solid Python
- Hands-on experience with dbt and Looker (or a similar BI tool)
- Experience with A/B testing and statistical significance
- Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication
- Background in logistics, supply chain or retail operations

Nice to have
- Snowflake
- Forecasting methods
- Experience mentoring analysts
